references.title: One shopping budget
mapping: A fixed budget makes the two feasible baskets mutually exclusive.
Choosing basket A forgoes the value of the best feasible alternative B, not the sum of all alternatives.
references.limitation: Prices alone do not determine personal benefit; money spent and opportunity cost need not coincide.
references.diagnostic: If three baskets are possible, do we add the benefits of both rejected baskets?
references.transfer: A free evening permits either a paid shift worth 70 or a class worth 90 to you. What is the opportunity cost of the class?
